findings.title: Windows Netlogon CVE-2026-41089 — Pre-Auth RCE on Domain Controllers Actively Exploited 20 Days After May Patch Tuesday
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Windows Server (Netlogon service) — all supported Windows Server SKUs running domain controller role
findings.summary: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Netlogon enables unauthenticated remote code execution on domain controllers; Microsoft patched 2026-05-12 without flagging exploitation risk and Belgian CCB confirmed active in-the-wild exploitation 2026-06-01.

findings.title: Miasma Supply-Chain Worm — 7 @redhat-cloud-services npm Packages Trojanized via Compromised Red Hat Employee GitHub Account
findings.affected_technology: npm @redhat-cloud-services namespace (vulnerabilities-client, tsc-transform-imports, topological-inventory-client, sources-client, rule-components, remediations-client, rbac-client) — ~117K weekly combined downloads
findings.summary: Mini Shai-Hulud derivative codenamed Miasma trojanized 7 Red Hat npm packages with a preinstall hook exfiltrating cloud credentials and CI secrets to an Anthropic-API-impersonator domain, with novel GCP/Azure identity collectors and per-infection encrypted payloads.

findings.title: codexui-android npm — OpenAI Codex Non-Expiring Refresh-Token Theft via Trojan Package, ~30K Weekly Downloads, 50-Day Undetected Exfil
findings.affected_technology: OpenAI Codex CLI (~/.codex/auth.json) — every developer who installed codexui-android since 2026-04-10; also Android app OpenClaw Codex Claude AI Agent (50K+ downloads)
findings.summary: Malicious codexui-android npm package silently exfiltrated non-expiring OpenAI Codex refresh tokens for ~50 days before discovery, enabling indefinite silent impersonation of every affected developer's Codex session.

findings.title: Vitest CVE-2026-47429 + CVE-2026-47428 — Critical RCE in Widely-Deployed JavaScript Test Framework via UI / Browser Mode
findings.affected_technology: vitest <4.1.0 (file-serving bypass RCE) and @vitest/browser 4.0.17-<4.1.6 / 5.0.0-beta.0-<5.0.0-beta.3 (XSS-to-RCE) — Vite/Vue/Svelte ecosystem default testing framework
findings.summary: Two critical Vitest advisories enable RCE via UI-mode file-serving bypass on Windows and via @vitest/browser otelCarrier query-parameter XSS leading to VITEST_API_TOKEN recovery and authenticated file-write API abuse.

findings.title: Operation Dragon Weave (China-Aligned) — AZUREVEIL AdaptixC2 Agent Using Azure Blob Storage as Dead-Drop C2 Against Czech Republic + Taiwan
findings.affected_technology: Government, research, academic, technology, financial-services targets in Czech Republic and Taiwan; AdaptixC2 framework deployment
findings.summary: Seqrite Labs disclosed a sustained China-aligned spear-phishing campaign delivering RUSTCLOAK loader and AZUREVEIL AdaptixC2 agent that uses Azure Blob Storage containers as dead-drop C2 channels.

findings.title: DriveSurge IAB — Thousands of Compromised Sites Funnel Visitors into ClickFix + FakeUpdate Chains via zTDS, Now Targeting macOS
findings.affected_technology: Compromised public-facing websites (WordPress + generic CMS) used as malware-distribution infrastructure; ClickFix + FakeUpdate lures targeting Windows + macOS browser fleets
findings.summary: Silent Push disclosed a pay-per-install initial-access broker DriveSurge using a custom traffic-distribution system to deliver ClickFix and FakeUpdate lures, now extended to macOS desktop targeting.

findings.title: WordPress Steam-Profile-as-Dead-Drop Campaign — 1,980 Infected WordPress Sites Use Steam Community Comments as C2 Channel
findings.affected_technology: WordPress (compromised via stolen credentials / vulnerable themes / plugins) — ~1,980 active infected sites; Steam Community profile comments as C2
findings.summary: GoDaddy detailed a 10-month-running campaign infecting ~1,980 WordPress sites that fetch commands from Steam Community profile comments encoded with invisible Unicode characters, eliminating dedicated C2 infrastructure.

findings.title: Meta AI Support Chatbot Abused to Hijack High-Profile Instagram Accounts via Password-Reset MFA Bypass
findings.affected_technology: Meta / Instagram account recovery flow — AI customer-support chatbot with email-change authority during password reset
findings.summary: Pro-Iranian actors used Meta's AI customer-support chatbot to associate attacker-controlled email addresses with target Instagram accounts during password reset, briefly hijacking Obama White House and U.S. Space Force accounts before Meta deployed an emergency patch.

noted.product: Apache Airflow (17th CVE; addendum to MEMORY 2026-06-01 16-CVE batch) — improper redaction of sensitive fields in Connection Extra API responses
noted.summary: Newly-disclosed 17th Apache Airflow CVE addendum to yesterday's 16-CVE batch; apply alongside the existing fixes.

noted.product: Apache Calcite — authenticated user-controlled models load arbitrary classes for code execution
noted.summary: Apache Calcite class-loading flaw enabling code execution via user-controlled models; affects downstream Druid/Beam/Hive/Flink/Phoenix that bundle Calcite.

noted.product: Apache Directory LDAP API client — fails to validate server certificate hostname matching
noted.summary: MitM-class LDAP client cert-validation defect with broad enterprise Java-LDAP blast radius.

noted.product: Apache Fesod (Incubating) — SSRF via inadequate URL validation
noted.summary: Apache Fesod SSRF; incubator-stage with limited deployment, logged for visibility.

noted.product: pip (Python package installer) — console/GUI script extraction outside install directory
noted.summary: pip script-extraction directory escape; potential CI/CD supply-chain abuse vector if a malicious wheel is permitted to install.
Low-impact heap OOB read in Perl Sereal::Decoder; only relevant to Perl services parsing untrusted Sereal input.

noted.product: bmcweb (OpenBMC web server) — four vulnerabilities, two unfixed (Full Disclosure 2026-05-31)
noted.summary: Four bmcweb vulnerabilities including two unfixed; OOB management plane attack surface on hyperscaler-grade rackmount servers.

noted.product: PC Tools Internet Security PCTCore64.sys driver (CERT/CC VU#158530) — BYOVD candidate
noted.summary: Discontinued-product signed driver usable as BYOVD primitive for credential extraction and cross-process handle manipulation; add to WDAC / Vulnerable Driver Block List.

noted.product: HP Poly VVX and Trio VoIP Phones (Rapid7) — pre-auth stack buffer overflow
noted.summary: Critical pre-auth stack overflow in HP Poly VoIP phones; OOS for most corporate perimeters since VoIP is typically internal-VLAN only.

noted.product: Mennekes Amtron Series EV-charging-station multiple vulnerabilities (CyberDanube 20260528-0)
noted.summary: OT/EV-charging vulnerabilities; OOS for corporate perimeter but logged as OT-infrastructure calibration data.

noted.product: Dashlane password manager — credential-stuffing brute-force wave 2026-05-31 → 2026-06-01
noted.summary: External credential-stuffing wave against Dashlane accounts; vendor confirms no platform compromise.

noted.product: Spain National Police doxer arrest — 'Police-ESP-Doxed' actor doxing government employees
noted.summary: Individual arrested 2026-05-27 for publishing personal data of Spanish govt staff via prior-breach + OSINT data aggregation; not a system compromise event.
